pickerMetaDescription: Pick your municipality and Notis messages you on WhatsApp when something at the council concerns you.
pickerTitle: Know what happens in your municipality
lead: Notis follows the municipal councils and committees, and lets you know when something concerns you.
introNote: He writes only when something concerns you — most weeks, nothing. One STOP ends it, whenever you like.
alreadySubscribedBody: You are already on the list. The next steps change what concerns you and where he writes.
preferencesLead: Pick places and topics. You can change them any time.
locationsHint: Your home, your work, a neighbourhood.
phoneChannelBlurb: Notis writes when something concerns you and answers when you ask.
phoneHint: No WhatsApp? It works over SMS.
emailChannelBlurb: Before and after each meeting, with more items than you get on your phone.
accountHint: So you can change your preferences.
emailHint: You sign in with a link in your email, no password.
consent: One STOP ends it, whenever you like. Notis's messages are written with artificial intelligence.

firstMessageBody: Η εγγραφή σου στις ειδοποιήσεις του OpenCouncil ολοκληρώθηκε. Σε αυτόν τον αριθμό θα σε ενημερώνει ο Νότης, ο βοηθός του OpenCouncil, για τις συνεδριάσεις του δήμου σου — μόνο όταν κάτι σε αφορά. Για ερωτήσεις σχετικά με τον δήμο σου ή τις ειδοποιήσεις σου, απάντησε σε αυτό το μήνυμα.
